page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 310.0 GB of system memory. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No local storage is bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in large language model (LLM) inference. For a small 135M model, prompt processing reaches 9,711.08 tokens per second and text generation achieves 456.51 tokens per second. With a medium 7B model, prompt processing is measured at 2,509.43 tokens per second and text generation at 90.44 tokens per second. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, image processing, and CPU encryption tests show strong performance in the top 25% tier. Standard CPU and memory bandwidth benchmarks fall within the average range.

The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which represents a key architectural tradeoff for I/O-heavy workloads. Qualitatively, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and an enterprise-grade NVIDIA A10 GPU offers a balanced resource density for specialized workloads. This hardware profile is suited for mid-sized LLM inference, image processing, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and GPU-accelerated compute workloads.
